name: voltride-platform
description: VoltRide e-bike store — system docs and orchestration for the multi-repo microservices demo

scripts.dev: concurrently -n catalog,cart,inventory,orders,pricing,notify,web -c blue,cyan,green,yellow,magenta,red,white "npm --prefix ../voltride-catalog run dev" "npm --prefix ../voltride-cart run dev" "cd ../voltride-inventory && go run ." "cd ../voltride-orders && go run ." "../voltride-pricing/.venv/bin/uvicorn main:app --app-dir ../voltride-pricing --port 4005 --reload" "../voltride-notifications/.venv/bin/uvicorn main:app --app-dir ../voltride-notifications --port 4006 --reload" "npm --prefix ../voltride-frontend run dev"
